requirement: The system must allow for fast transmission of rough images every 0.5 sec. This may be assisted through the use of data-loss compression techniques

targets.possible_definition: Compression techniques that trade image fidelity to enable rapid transmission of rough images every 0.5 seconds.

requirement: The system shall transmit data  between Gemini and home Institutes using a FITS format and contain all header information provided with the data.

targets.possible_definition: Flexible Image Transport System; a standard file format that encapsulates data alongside complete header metadata.
External institutional organizations receiving FITS-formatted data transmitted from Gemini.

requirement: Handshaking of commands between IOCs must occur within 100-200 msec, signaling acceptance of each command.

targets.possible_definition: An automated command-exchange protocol between controllers to acknowledge and signal acceptance of commands within 100-200 ms.
Input/Output Controllers that process, accept, and acknowledge commands via rapid handshaking.

requirement: The system shall support the standard ARPA services (telnet, FTP, SMTP, etc) as well as NFS, RPC, IPC, and the Unix socket interface library.

targets.possible_definition: A collection of standard network protocols and services including telnet, FTP, and SMTP.
A standard network service providing remote terminal connections.
File Transfer Protocol; a network service used for transferring files across system interfaces.
Simple Mail Transfer Protocol; a standard service used for sending electronic mail.
Network File System; a distributed file system protocol supported by the network.
Remote Copy Protocol; a service enabling remote file copying between hosts.
Inter-Process Communication; mechanism allowing distinct processes to share data and coordinate actions.

requirement: The system shall support data compression using a loss-less compression technique for transmission across the system LAN.

targets.possible_definition: A compression method that reduces file size without losing any original data during LAN transmission.
Local Area Network; the local high-speed network infrastructure used for data transmission.

requirement: The system shall support interactive and queue-based observing modes

targets.possible_definition: An observing mode that allows real-time user engagement and direct system manipulation.
An observing mode where tasks are scheduled and executed automatically in sequential order.
Configured operational states governing how astronomical observations are conducted.

requirement: The interactive observing mode shall only be supported through the OCS

targets.possible_definition: Direct user-driven operation of the system.
The specific operating state controlling observation execution.
Observatory Control System; the core software infrastructure that exclusively mediates interactive observing.

requirement: The operations staff shall control the Gemini 8m Telescopes indirectly via a scheduler program or directly via commands.

targets.possible_definition: An automated program used by staff to indirectly queue and manage telescope operations.
Authorized personnel responsible for managing and commanding the Gemini 8m Telescopes.

requirement: The system shall support access from WAN for remote diagnostics from operations facilities

targets.possible_definition: Wide Area Network; external long-distance telecommunication network providing remote diagnostic access.
Troubleshooting and system health evaluations performed from distant locations.
Off-site or remote locations where operational personnel conduct diagnostics.
